description:
“It’s sexual frustration. Sex will fix it.”

Meet Hwang Da-eun, a walking medical encyclopedia with stress-induced gastritis and constant headaches. As usual, she ignores her best mate Lee Sujin’s constant preaching about sex being the cure-all for everything.

“Everyone deals with stress, so why am I the only one suffering?!”

You know what they say, persistence breaks resistance! Da-eun finally gives in to Sujin’s suggestion and decides to look for a guy to help her out...

“In this day and age, where can you even find a decent, safe guy?”

Hold on... What’s this? There actually is one? And he’s fit, looks delicious, and is good-looking to boot?

“Yoon Juwon? Have you… done it before?” “I haven’t done it.”

Wait, he’s never done it before either. This kind of chance doesn’t come around twice.

“Wanna come to my place? I don’t think I’ve had enough to drink.”
“Sure.”

Will Da-eun get her hands on Juwon and recover her health? A battle of wits and passion in this romantic comedy where the two navigate both their hearts and bodies! (From [Neijude Teeny Scans](https://mangabaka.org/group/6f08qqt/neijude-teeny-scans))
